meta.title: Quote selection (dsh-client-ui-quote)
meta.description: Select any sentence in the chat, a file preview or the terminal to quote it, Kimi-Code style: the floating bar offers Comment, Add to conversation and Side chat, the first two insert a DSH reference chip into the composer, and the third writes the quote into the composer of one independent side thread per conversation in the right sidebar without sending it (needs dsh-better-sidebar). Alt+Q / Alt+C / Alt+B do the same three things, hovering a sent quote can jump back to its source, and the right sidebar's Quote list page searches every quote of the session, jumps back to any of them and exports them as Markdown (Alt+L), and its footer takes a side thread's conclusion back into the main composer or exports it as a file.
